coursework_rule.weekly: Weeks 1 to 5 stay weekly. Week 6 is waived for all three cohorts. The best 3 of the 5 weekly quizzes (each out of 5) and the best 3 of the 5 weekly assignments (each out of 20) count.
coursework_rule.blocks: A block is never dropped. Its marks are the sum of its parts: Block 1 quiz = Q7 + Q8 = 10; Block 2 quiz = Q9 + Q10 = 10; Block 1 assignment = A7 + A8 = 40; Block 2 assignment = A9 + A10 + A11 = 60. A part that is not submitted scores zero.
coursework_rule.quizzes_out_of: 3 x 5 + 10 + 10 = 35 marks; the percentage of the course is marks earned divided by 35, times 15.
coursework_rule.assignments_out_of: 3 x 20 + 40 + 60 = 160 marks; the percentage of the course is marks earned divided by 160, times 15.
coursework_rule.why: A block carries its classes, so a student cannot drop one. The two blocks hold 20 of the 35 quiz marks and 100 of the 160 assignment marks.

provisional_mode.purpose: Semester 1 results can be published before the project is marked.
provisional_mode.project_is_pending_when: either project column is blank. A blank is unmarked; a typed 0 is a mark of zero.
provisional_mode.project_is_marked_when: both ML Project Part A and ML Project Part B hold a number. Enter 0 for a student who submitted nothing once marking is finished.
provisional_mode.while_pending: Final % and Band are blank. The sheet shows the provisional line and 'Project: PENDING'. A final percentage or grade band is never shown that treats an unmarked project as zero.
provisional_mode.once_marked: Final % is the full total out of 100: quizzes + assignments + data analysis project + Practical Test 1 + project Part A + Part B. The provisional line is cleared.
provisional_mode.not_pending: A student with a missing quiz or assignment part still scores zero for it. A blank data analysis project or Practical Test 1 also counts as zero and is listed under Missing. Only the project can be pending.
provisional_mode.x: marks earned over the four marked components, out of 55 (the weighted points, 15 + 15 + 10 + 15)
provisional_mode.y: x divided by 55, times 100, rounded half up to two places
